newsitem.title: USA: Spectran gets $35 mln order for fiber.
newsitem.headline: Spectran gets $35 mln order for fiber.

text.p: SpecTran Corp said Monday it has received a $35 million order from Lucent Technologies Inc for multimode fiber.

SpecTran Chairman Raymond Jaeger said in a statement that the order "presents an opportunity for improved revenue growth since fiber supplied under this contract will be manufactured under Lucent's patent rights and, as such, these sales will not be subject to SpecTran's patent licenses."
The term of the contract runs through December 31, 1999, with a provision for a possible extension beyond that date.
